mainEntity.name: How involved will I be in the custom home construction process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your level of involvement in custom home construction can be tailored to your preference. As the homeowner, you are central to decision-making during the design phase, from architectural style to material selections. Once construction begins, our team manages the day-to-day operations, including scheduling, subcontractor coordination, and quality control. However, we maintain open communication, providing regular updates, conducting site visits at key milestones, and promptly addressing any questions or concerns. Your input is vital at various stages, ensuring the final home aligns perfectly with your vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Your involvement is highest during design and material selection. During construction, we manage daily operations but keep you informed with regular updates and site visits.
